⬡ 01 — WHY NOWMachine speed changed the clock.

In November 2026, an FBI warning described an AI hacking tool, ARTEX, in use since at least August. In some intrusions it reached privileged access in under three hours. That is the fastest reported, not the typical case. The same week, the European Commission confirmed an AI-generated cyber campaign against its systems, detected in October.

Most organisations still run on human-speed processes, with departments that do not share one view of the truth. That gap is where AI-speed threats, and AI-speed mistakes, get in.Sources: FBI FLASH on ARTEX, 13 Nov 2026, as reported by BleepingComputer (15 Nov 2026); European Commission briefing of 19 Nov 2026, as reported by Brussels Signal. The Commission has not linked its incident to ARTEX.
